title: A smooth morphism has standard-smooth affine charts of its relative dimension
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of pure relative dimension $d$. For every $x\in X$ there are affine open neighbourhoods $V=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $x$ and $T=\operatorname{Spec}R$ of $f(x)$, with $f(V)\subseteq T$, such that the ring map $R\to A$ of $f|_V$ is standard smooth of relative dimension $d$ (equivalently, locally it factors through an etale map to $\mathbf A^d_R$).
